objective: Prepare a bounded visible Worker task for Reversible Flyway migration without data loss
expected_change: The implementation is limited to db/migration/V1__create_loan.sql and respects governed acceptance.

human_story.title: Implement Reversible Flyway migration without data loss
human_story.need: A bounded implementation tied to a declared scope
human_story.benefit: A testable patch without scope expansion

technical_notes.specialty: Reversible Flyway migration without data loss

acceptance_criteria.then: Only the declared change may be delivered

invariants.statement: All changed files remain inside the resolved write scope.

negative_controls.prohibited: Modifying protected tests or leaking the hidden oracle.

positive.statement: The requested change is limited to the declared file.

edge.statement: An attempted edit to another file must be blocked.

regression.statement: Protected tests and hidden oracle remain unchanged and unseen.

blocked_if.condition: The current PG-00 C6 version and concrete STD rules are not attested for the task.
Any planned write falls outside PG-05 C2 exact write scope.
Any hidden oracle information reaches the Worker-visible task.
The migration can delete or irreversibly alter existing data.
